response.text:
Short answer — yes, it matters briefly, but for any meeting in November 2026 your 09:00 New York call will be 14:00 (2:00 PM) London.  

UK clocks went back to GMT on Sunday 25 October 2026, and US clocks return to EST on Sunday 1 November 2026, so from 1 Nov onward the offset is five hours. ([gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/when-do-the-clocks-change?utm_source=openai)) ([timeanddate.com](https://www.timeanddate.com/time/change/uk?utm_source=openai))

Two-line note to send to London attendees:
- Quick note: for our November meetings, 09:00 New York = 14:00 (2:00 PM) London (GMT).  
- Please join at 14:00 GMT and update your calendar invites if needed.
